meta.disclosure: Deterministic replay of the pre-registered one-shot held-out test (results/final_heldout_s300-319.json), held-out traces (split by whole trace id), fresh seeds 300-319, run once. Reproduced here read-only for visualisation; nothing is tuned. GEO (S3/S6) is a measurement-parameterised MODEL, not a replay. S2/S8 LEO standby and S7/S4 LTE standby are STITCHED: measured independently, only time-aligned. S5 is a real SIMULTANEOUS two-subflow capture. A faithful emulation of the documented 9001-R design, not a benchmark of the physical appliance.

reproduction.note: Outage per transition + AoI p95 + alert/voice gate rates + instance counts reproduce the frozen one-shot BIT-EXACT. Standby/emission AIRTIME (and the score / video_goodput that depend on it) reproduce to <=1 tick (0.1 s) per run, because the frozen run used the SPEC §13.8 anti-gaming observable-clock offset with an UNRECORDED, per-worker-random salt; that offset perturbs the policy's delta-timer rounding by ~2e-11 s, flipping a standby teardown/return by one tick in a few runs. Outage is unaffected. This replay pins a fixed salt so it is itself fully deterministic.
reproduction.recommendation: For a future bit-exact replay, re-freeze the one-shot with KATIM_EVAL_SALT pinned (a ~6-min re-run); nothing else changes.

scenario_construction.S1_lte5g_walk: single real replay (UCC 5G Download capture), anchored on a real persistent degradation event
scenario_construction.S2_5g_leo_drive: STITCHED: UCC 5G replay + Starlink LEO (measured seconds CONCATENATED, unmeasured gaps removed), measured independently and only time-aligned
scenario_construction.S3_5g_geo_drive: UCC 5G replay + GEO measurement-parameterised MODEL (not a replay)
scenario_construction.S4_wifi_edge: STITCHED: Meireles Wi-Fi replay + UCC 4G LTE car replay, measured independently and only time-aligned
scenario_construction.S5_mptcp_hsr: real SIMULTANEOUS capture (HSR-MPTCP, two carrier subflows), no stitching
scenario_construction.S6_collective_5g_geo: UCC 5G replay + GEO measurement-parameterised MODEL (not a replay), 15-user collective load
scenario_construction.S7_lumos_walk: STITCHED: Lumos5G walking mmWave 5G replay (gateway capped to X9000R <=100 Mbps) + UCC 4G LTE PEDESTRIAN standby, independently measured, only time-aligned
scenario_construction.S8_lumos_drive: STITCHED: Lumos5G driving mmWave 5G replay (gateway capped to 9001-R <=1 Gbps) + Starlink LEO standby (measured seconds CONCATENATED)

meta.construction_common: Capacity = UPLINK (red->black) direction: measured UL for Starlink and the GEO model; DL x UL/DL ratio 0.53 (Berlin V2X measured LTE) for cellular DL-only traces. RTT where a trace has none = labelled seeded draw from measured UCC 5G ping samples (Wi-Fi: class default).
meta.timeline_downsample: 1 Hz baseline; full 10 Hz within +/-15s of each transition
